what: The site bar on every page of this site (blackbox_agent viewer CONTRACT §18, drawn by the blackbox_agent package's bb-site-nav, which its build puts at dashboard/viewer/src/components/bb-site-nav.js): the box's name (to the landing page) then the open dashboard with ▾ in the top row, its menu listing every dashboard under its group's heading ("layout": "switcher"; "two-rows" spreads the dashboards out as tabs instead), the open dashboard's own tabs or pages below. Hand-written; every href is relative to this file and inside the site (dashboard/ and the landing index.html are the package's build). A dashboard joins by adding one entry here and its id in order. Zach, 2026-11-24: "So right now we want a tab for Trajectory Coverage and Trajectory Comparison. And also one for Model x Dataset." Zach, 2026-11-24 ~21:30, on the switcher: "its still the top row tabs but instead of having them spread out its the drop down"
